patch_list: Stops Sentry, the Facebook SDK, AppsFlyer, and on-device ad retargeting.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Stops the app from reacting when you take a screenshot.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Removes the "Follow" upsell card in the Notes feed.
